security.title: Enterprise-grade security, by default
security.lead: Your data is the most valuable thing you trust us with. Access control, encryption and AI transparency are built into the platform — not sold as an add-on.

signIn.title: Enterprise sign-in
signIn.text: SSO via Microsoft Entra and two-factor authentication. When someone leaves, access is revoked centrally in one action.

roles.title: Roles and access levels
roles.text: Custom roles and permissions down to confidential fields: HR sees salaries, legal sees contracts, only you see everything.

signing.title: Built-in signing
signing.text: Draw your signature once — it's applied to documents you sign, and every signature is recorded in the audit history.

noLeaks.title: AI without leaks
noLeaks.text: Zero Data Retention: your company data is never stored by model providers or used for training. A human confirms agent actions.

export.title: Your data belongs to you
export.text: Full export anytime: Excel reports, documents, API with OAuth. No data held hostage — leave freely, even if we’d rather you stayed.

audit.title: Audit and history
audit.text: Every action on a document or task is logged: who opened, who approved, who signed and when. Disputes are settled by history, not memory.

items.q: Where is our data stored and who can access it?
items.a: Access is governed by your workspace roles and permissions — you decide who sees what, down to confidential fields. Sign-in supports SSO via Microsoft Entra and two-factor authentication.

items.q: The AI reads our documents. Is that safe?
items.a: Darvis runs in Zero Data Retention mode: your company data is never stored by model providers or used for training. A human confirms key agent actions.

Freemium is free forever (tasks, document workflow, HR, dashboards, chats) — no credit card. Paid plans are a flat price per user per month: one subscription instead of 5–6 separate tools. Your counterparties always sign documents for free.
You draw your signature once, and it is applied to the documents you sign. Every step is recorded in the audit history, and your counterparties always sign for free.

items.q: How reliable is this? What happens to our data if something goes wrong?
items.a: Darlean is built by DAR Solutions, with teams in the US and Europe. Your data belongs to you: export is available anytime, including Excel reports and the API.

items.q: What if the team doesn’t adopt a new system?
items.a: You can create tasks by voice through Darvis, and we help with import, setup and training — most teams are working by day one. Calendars sync two-way with Google and Outlook, so familiar tools keep working.
